title: Hebrew Bible, Westminster Leningrad Codex (full Tanakh, one verse per line, pointed text)
period: Masoretic text as in the Leningrad Codex (1008 CE); Biblical Hebrew
notes: WLC text released into the public domain by the J. Alan Groves Center (tanach.us); redistributed in scrollmapper/bible_databases (MIT repository). 5,566,310 bytes. Vowel points and cantillation are combining marks and are removed by vs/refcorpus.normalize; verse numbers and book headings in Latin script are removed too. refcorpus.normalize(..., 'hebrew') on the file gives 1,511,071 characters. Biblical rather than late-medieval Hebrew: it fixes the power gap, not the period fit.
